title: Add revise/stop paths and Athena's own plan checks to job planning
summary: Implement job 4 of the job-planning design: a multi-round planner loop (revise with a quoting brief; stop on reject, misread, or last-round revise), free Athena checks before the critic, a planning-stopped failure with unknown verification, and retry carry of the last critique's findings. Audience: the maintainer verifying via cargo test and the design's F11.

defaults_applied.how: New cargo tests for each path; clippy and fmt required.
Criteria run tests checking the behaviors, not just existence.
One focused change to the planning loop and checks.
Behavior criteria name commands the verifier can run.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 3a/3b accept path lives in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs and plan.rs; the new loop extends it rather than replacing it.
max_rounds already exists or is added with default 3 in config; athena.toml itself is not edited.
Unknown verification_passed is represented by an existing optional/None value in the outcome record.
Tests go in crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs using the fake agent.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a test where the planner revises then accepts shows the second planner prompt contains the first finding's text, and the job lands.

Run cargo test: a test where every round says revise asserts no producer or verifier invocation, outcome failed with reason starting 'planning stopped before any code was written:' plus the findings, three plans and three critiques committed, totals counting all six planning invocations, verification_passed unknown (not false), and check_history() clean.

Run cargo test: a plan editing an unlisted athena.toml, or citing a command outside the verifier's grant (per athena_agent::policy::evaluate), yields an Athena critique with a major finding and zero critic invocations.
Run cargo test: a retry of a job stopped in planning carries the last critique's findings into the new reading's brief via earlier_attempt.

Athena checks cover: exactly one demonstration per criterion; behavior demos have fails_without and an allowed command; modify paths exist and create paths do not; governance paths use admission::is_governance and governance_change_is_listed (major otherwise); other unlisted paths are minor findings.
Rounds are bounded by max_rounds (default 3); reject, a misread reading, or revise in the last round stops the job; the revision brief quotes the previous plan and every finding.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, and the xtask boundary test (cargo test -p xtask); all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the revise/stop paths and Athena's plan checks; athena.toml is unchanged.

out_of_scope: Recovery of a job killed during planning
departures: Larger than typical: multi-module change with four integration tests and a design-review requirement, so higher cost and lower pass rate than reference.
